theme_strategy: Hybrid: Toggle for Public Landing Page (Light/Dark). Forced Light Theme for Dashboards to ensure cognitive comfort during long viewing sessions.

headings.usage: Use for all H1, H2, H3. Highly legible, modern, conveys intelligence.

body.usage: Use for all paragraphs, labels, body text. Soft, accessible, reduces eye strain.

mono.usage: Use for CBT/Try Out timers, exam scores, and data grids.

primary.name: Intellect Blue
primary.usage: CTAs, active navigation, progress indicators. Evokes trust and mental clarity.

accent.name: Vivid Amber
accent.usage: Alerts, secondary CTAs, focus points, 'Job Bidding' highlights. Striking without vibrating.

background_dashboard.name: Soft Slate
background_dashboard.usage: Main dashboard background. Very comfortable for long study sessions.

grids.bento_marketing: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 with gap-8 to gap-12 for high visual impact and asymmetry.
grids.dashboard_dense: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6 for data correlation.

layouts.global_spacing: Use 2-3x typical spacing. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8).
layouts.public_landing: Modular sections with generous whitespace. Bento grid for features. Hero with Bold outcome-driven headline, Primary CTA + Secondary 'Watch Overview'.
layouts.dashboards_general: Task-first layout. Left sidebar navigation, top header (search, profile). Main area with dense grid. Cardless, rectangular styles with minimal borders (1px solid #E2E8F0).

portal_specifics.student: Progress-centric. Hero row with next lesson, CBT/TryOut engine. Grid for course catalog.
portal_specifics.admin: Control center. Data-heavy lists, dense Shadcn tables for course/schedule/TO management.
portal_specifics.tutor: Job bidding feed, clear calendar widget for personal schedule, class management lists.
portal_specifics.proctor: Live monitoring matrix, performance trend charts, report download center.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E2E8F0. Subtle to maintain structure without clutter.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Only for sticky header on Landing Page: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70. DO NOT use fully transparent backgrounds under text.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal ambient shadow for hover states (shadow-md). Flat for static cards.

motion.interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements (lift -translate-y-1). Explicit hover text colors.
motion.transitions: Use specific properties: transition-transform duration-200, transition-colors duration-200. NO transition-all.
motion.loading: Skeleton loading states for CBT engines and analytics.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 ratio for normal text. Avoid light grey text on white.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

component_name.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-md. Primary: bg-[#0E7490] text-white hover:bg-[#344ED0].
component_name.cards: Go cardless where possible. When needed, use rounded-lg with 1px border. No excessive box-shadow.
component_name.forms: Always use Shadcn input, select, date-picker. DO NOT use native HTML <select> or <input type='date'>.
component_name.tables: Shadcn tables for all data lists (Admin, Proctor).
component_name.charts: Shadcn chart components (recharts) for Proctor Analytics.
component_name.toasts: Use Sonner component for notifications (e.g., successful bidding).

image_urls.description: Group of modern students. Primary hero image for the LMS value proposition.
Interactive learning environment. Use for 'Interactive Learning Room' showcase.
Teacher presenting to class. Use for 'Job Bidding' and 'Tutor Dashboard' promotions.

3d_libraries.steps: 1. yarn add framer-motion 2. Import motion from framer-motion 3. Apply smooth staggered entrances in Landing Page and Job Bidding feeds.
3d_libraries.instructions: Keep Dashboard interactions lightweight. Use framer-motion sparingly for reveals.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement 5 distinct portals based on Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Guest (Landing), Student, Admin, Tutor, Proctor.
Build a robust layout wrapper with Sidebar (for dashboards) and Header.
Use Shadcn UI extensively for forms, tables, and dialogs.
For Proctor analytics, implement Shadcn Charts.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). It disrupts natural reading flow.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Do not use generic placeholder image URLs. Use the provided ones.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive and key informational elements.
Use 'sonner' for toasts. Sonner component located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js
Ensure hover states explicitly set text colors, e.g., hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white.
Limit the use of PRIMARY color to CTAs and active states.
DO NOT use transition-all. Target specific properties.
Grid items MUST be direct children of grid containers.
